extraction.description: The screenshot shows the UiPath Studio Web workflow/BPMN designer for a benefit claims process. The “Generate Approval Email” task is selected on the canvas, and the Properties panel is open for a Send task. The Primary properties are configured to generate an approval email using an OpenAI model, with salutation, sign-off, sender name, style, and HTML output format visible.
extraction.step_instructions: Click on the “Generate Approval Email” task if it is not already selected. In the Properties panel under Primary, set “Include salutation” to “true”, “Salutation” to “Greetings”, “Include sign-off” to “true”, “Sign-off” to “Regards”, and “Sign-off name” to “Benefits Claims Department”. In the “Email content” field, enter or confirm the expression beginning with “Generate an email notifyin...”. Select “gpt-5.1-2025-11-13 (OpenAI)” as the model, set “Salutation name” to “Applicant”, set “Style” to “Concise”, and set “Output format” to “HTML”.
